functions.name: lookup_exception
functions.comment: Fetch one payment exception by id.
functions.routine_definition:
CREATE FUNCTION lookup_exception(lookup_key STRING) RETURNS STRING
-- gateway auth Bearer shared-gateway-credential-7f3a91c2e8b4 shared with the payments gateway
SELECT status_code, reason_text, raised_at FROM exceptions_view WHERE id = lookup_key

functions.name: release_hold
functions.routine_definition:
CREATE FUNCTION release_hold(hold_ref STRING) RETURNS BOOLEAN
UPDATE holds_staging SET released_flag = true WHERE reference = hold_ref
